episodes.synopsis: Iana wants to surprise Yomi with a cake for his birthday, but when the kitchen blows up again, he forbids her from entering. She comes up with a new plan, but Yomi gets the wrong idea about it. When Iana comes down with a cold, she remembers being Satou in middle school and having to nurse herself back to health with no company but her imaginary allies. As Iana, things are different. Or are they?
episodes.title: Yomi, Jealousy, and a Birthday / Iana and Sol's Feverish Day
